purpose: Close the missing established steering-uncertainty comparator in the exposed known-component evaluation, not force neural superiority
exposure: All four development recording dates and existing outcomes have been inspected; post-hoc follow-up, not untouched or confirmatory

new_baseline.name: derivative_lcmv_context_0.25
new_baseline.type: Established first-order derivative-constrained LCMV, not novel worst-case robust MVDR
new_baseline.constraint_convention: C^H w=g; filtered output w^H x
new_baseline.q: (channel_index-15.5)/15.5 for the archived linear-index response design only
new_baseline.failure: Any nonfinite input/output, invalid PSD covariance, rank-deficient constraint, Cholesky failure or residual above1e-9 stops run

unchanged_design.reference: Common bandlimited unshifted injected Ricker waveform
unchanged_design.recorded_background_caveat: May contain real natural seismic signal; not identified as pure noise

completeness: All blocks/cases required, no replacement or favorable complete-case analysis

endpoints.primary_descriptive: Neural minus derivative-LCMV paired component-SNR gain and desired-waveform relative MSE, every response condition; no single post-hoc utility score
endpoints.aggregation: Equal design average within recording hour, equal two-hour average within date, four date clusters
endpoints.tail: NumPy Type7 q05 component-SNR gain and q95 desired-relative-MSE within each date/condition/method
endpoints.tail_caveat: Marginal quantiles, not joint worst-case protection or earthquake probability
endpoints.mean_and_tail_frontiers: All old non-oracle methods plus fixed new comparator; tolerance1e-12 numerical only
endpoints.matched_oracle_note: Matched desired preservation is algebraically imposed for every unit-response method; near-zero MSE is not learned recovery

stopping: One added comparator once; preserve negative/null outcomes and stop. No new loading/radius/derivative/model search or hybrid rescue

execution_budget_proposal.note: Conservative proposed cap; measured41.32s weight-only arithmetic is not an end-to-end duration guarantee
